roster_grade.headline: 8-0 and #1 in points — hold the lineup, turn spare QBs into a young RB
roster_grade.window_explanation: #1 by record (8-0) and #1 in points for (617), but #5 by roster value. You're winning on production, so this is a win-now profile: protect every producing starter and spend true surplus (QB3/QB4, bench vets, picks) on the one soft spot, an aging RB room.

strengths.label: Best team in the league right now
strengths.detail: 8-0 with 617 points for, #1 in both. dickcole2410 (7-1, 609 PF) is the only team keeping pace.

strengths.label: QB depth nobody else has
strengths.detail: Mahomes, Shough, Nix, and now Jalon Daniels. Superflex only starts two, so Shough and Daniels are the trade chips.

strengths.label: Deep WR group
strengths.detail: Parker Washington, Higgins, and Watson start, with DeVonta Smith on the bench and Stribling coming back from IR.

strengths.label: Loveland plus extra picks
strengths.detail: Elite young TE1, plus an extra 2028 1st and 2027 2nd to deal from.

weaknesses.label: Aging RB room
weaknesses.detail: Henry (32), Javonte (26), and Hubbard (27) are all Declining. RB need is 0.4, the only real need on the roster.

weaknesses.label: Value lags the record
weaknesses.detail: #5 by roster value. Some regression is likely unless talent comes in.

weaknesses.label: Thin RB depth
weaknesses.detail: RJ Harvey is in the lineup now. One more RB injury and Kamara is starting.

roster_grade.most_urgent_action: Turn Tyler Shough into a young RB this week. Lemon Party (0-8) is weak at QB and RB, so Shough + RJ Harvey for Jeremiyah Love works for both sides. Backup plan: Hubbard + Jalon Daniels for Kyren Williams (You Hate Us). Keep Mahomes, Henry, and every starting WR.

QB.commentary: Four QBs for two slots. Shough and Daniels are pure surplus. Mahomes is on the bench this week, so check his status.

RB.commentary: Producing today, but every starter is aging and Harvey is filling a slot. This is the upgrade target.

WR.commentary: Three solid starters, with Smith as a quality WR4 and Stribling on IR.

TE.commentary: Loveland is elite and Hockenson is a starting-caliber TE2/flex.

trade_priority_order: Shough + RJ Harvey → Jeremiyah Love (Lemon Party, 0-8, weak at QB and RB)
Hubbard + Jalon Daniels → Kyren Williams (You Hate Us, Long shot, weak at RB)
All-in option: Shough + Javonte + 2027 2nd → Bijan Robinson (Bijan Mustard, 2-6)
Hold Mahomes, Henry, Loveland, and the starting WRs — you're 8-0
Sell Kamara to an RB-needy contender for a 2027 3rd

sell_now.reason: Your QB3 in a 2-QB league, and 0-8 Lemon Party is weak at QB. His value is highest while a seller still needs a starter.
QB4 who will never start for you. Rebuilders like a rookie QB, so he works as the second piece in an RB deal.
sell_now.ask: Package piece for Kyren Williams or Breece Hall

sell_now.reason: 31-year-old bench RB, and his value only drops from here.

buy_now.reason: 0-8 and weak at QB, RB, and WR. Shough + Harvey fills two of their holes for one rookie RB.

buy_now.from_team: You Hate Us Cuz You Anus
buy_now.reason: Long shot at 4-4, weak at RB. They get an RB back plus a young QB.
2-6 and selling. This is the all-in: Mahomes, Henry, Nix, and Harvey all stay.
Bench RB on a seller. Youth and a pick for a young RB, with no starters leaving.

do_not_trade: Derrick Henry — producing starter on an 8-0 team
Parker Washington / Tee Higgins / Christian Watson — starting WRs
trade_strategy.pick_strategy: You're 8-0, so picks are currency. Package 2nds through 4ths, including the extra 2027 2nd, for RB help. Hold the extra 2028 1st and your own 2027 1st unless they land Bijan or Love outright.

outlook.projected_power_rank: #1. Best record, most points, and #1 composite title odds.
outlook.three_year_outlook: Win now on the Mahomes/Loveland/WR core. A young RB this season (Love, Hall, or Bijan) also covers 2027, when Henry and Javonte age out.
outlook.season_narrative: The Jabroni Beaters are 8-0 at Week 5 and lead the league in points while ranking #5 in roster value. The lineup works, so protect it and fix the aging RB room. You have four QBs for two slots, and 0-8 Lemon Party needs a QB, so Shough and Daniels are how you pay for it.
key_risks: Regression, since you're outscoring your roster value
An RB injury now that Harvey is already in the lineup
Mahomes is on the bench this week. If he's hurt, Shough becomes a starter and less spendable
key_upside_factors: Landing Love, Kyren, or Bijan makes RB a strength
Stribling back from IR deepens WR
Extra 2028 1st and 2027 2nd to spend at the deadline
